paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
notes: ADMX haloscope search 645-680 MHz (2.66-2.81 ueV) reaching DFSZ sensitivity. The exclusion plot (Fig 4) shows |g_agg| in units of 10^-16 GeV^-1 vs axion mass; DFSZ coupling at ~2.8 ueV corresponds roughly to ~2e-16 GeV^-1 and KSVZ to ~5.4e-16 GeV^-1. The limit reaches just below DFSZ across the band. Exact per-mass numerical values are not tabulated; data points are approximate from the plot (~5e-16 GeV^-1 limit level, between DFSZ and KSVZ). Density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 for Maxwellian, 0.63 for N-body.
